quotes.text: Se dedica exclusivamente a las labores del hogar .........................3

assessments.reasoning: The supplied instrument does not contain a domestic or care work module separate from the main questionnaire. Domestic work is only referenced within Section 6 (Employment and Income) as an option for why a person could not start working (Part A, Question 5), why a person did not seek work (Part A, Question 8), why a person left their previous job (Part A, Question 18), or why a person worked fewer hours than usual (Part B, Question 5). Because unpaid domestic and care work is treated as a reason for inactivity or working fewer hours rather than measured in a dedicated module, the value is false and the exclusion type is treated_as_other.
